title: illicium ridleyanum
intro: Illicium ridleyanum, commonly known as Malaysian star anise or Ridley's star anise, is a plant species in the magnolia family that is native to Southeast Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Illicium ridleyanum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Illicium ridleyanum include limonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
